description: This file implements a React component for a login page with a two-step flow: first collecting email and fetching organizations, then authenticating with a password. It handles user input, API calls, navigation, and UI styling specific to this login flow.

methods.name: handleFetchOrgs
methods.description: Fetches user organizations based on email input and advances to the credentials step.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Performs login using provided email, organization context, and password, handling redirection and error states.
